    from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix

    pre = graph.graph.get('precomputed', {})
    bridge_ratio = pre.get('bridge_ratio_high_bc', 0.15)
    max_core = pre.get('max_core_k', 1)

    def normalize(arr):
        arr = np.array(arr, dtype=float)
        if arr.max() == arr.min():
            return np.ones_like(arr)
        return (arr - arr.min()) / (arr.max() - arr.min())

    # If first pick, choose node maximizing combined shifted sigmoid score
    visited_nodes = set(graph.nodes()) - set(unvisited_nodes)
    if not visited_nodes:
        degs = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['degree'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
        clusts = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
        betws = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
        eigs = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['eigenvector'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)

        deg_n = normalize(degs) + 1e-12
        clust_n = normalize(clusts) + 1e-12
        betw_n = normalize(betws) + 1e-12
        eig_n = normalize(eigs) + 1e-12

        # Shifted sigmoid to emphasize low clustering and betweenness
        def shifted_sigmoid(x, shift=0.5, steep=10):
            return 1 / (1 + np.exp(steep * (x - shift)))

        score = deg_n * eig_n * shifted_sigmoid(clust_n) * shifted_sigmoid(betw_n)
        idx = np.argmax(score)
        return unvisited_nodes[idx]

    # Extract features for unvisited and visited nodes

        return np.array([graph.nodes[n][attr] for n in arr_nodes], dtype=float)

    deg_unv = get_attr(unvisited_nodes, 'degree')

    clust_v = get_attr(visited_nodes, 'clustering')
    betw_v = get_attr(visited_nodes, 'betweenness')
    eig_v = get_attr(visited_nodes, 'eigenvector')
    deg_v = get_attr(visited_nodes, 'degree')

        1 - betw_unv_n,

        1 - clust_v_n,
